responsibility: Contains the autogenerated documentation URL mapping for the Solaris option table in gcc/config/sol2.opt. It associates Solaris-recognized driver and target switches such as -G, -mclear-hwcap, -mimpure-text, -pthreads, and -rdynamic with their GCC manual anchors, while preserving notes for ambiguous options like pthread. Its role is documentation cross-reference metadata for Solaris option definitions.
